### Work Order 4 Completion Report: PreToolUse Gates

#### Summary of Implementation & Verification

1. **PreToolUse Handler (`internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go`)**:
   - Implemented [`HandlePreToolUse`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go#L85-L204) with strict fail-closed safety (always returns valid `{"decision":"allow"}` or structured gating responses, never `{}` or empty bytes).
   - Defined [`PreToolUsePayload`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go#L18-L31) with [`Normalize()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go#L33-L46) supporting both camelCase and snake_case payload attributes.
   - Defined [`PreToolUseResponse`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go#L48-L51) (`Decision`, `Reason`).
   - Implemented fast exits returning `{"decision":"allow"}` for:
     - `REPO_MEMORY_DISABLED=1` or `REPO_MEMORY_HOUSEKEEPING=1`
     - Non-edit tools (only gates `replace_file_content` and `write_to_file`)
     - Unenrolled workspaces or unresolvable workspace roots
     - Missing or empty target file in tool arguments
     - JSON unmarshal failures or index open errors
   - Target file extraction handles both raw JSON arguments and nested/quoted string payloads.
   - Gate evaluation queries [`delivery.Engine.GateEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L249). Gated edits return `{"decision":"force_ask","reason":"..."}` formatted via [`delivery.FormatGateDeny`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/formatter.go#L89) to prompt confirmation without hard-blocking on retry.

2. **Hook Dispatch Wiring (`cmd/repo-memory/cmd_hook.go`)**:
   - Wired [`antigravity.HandlePreToolUse`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/cmd/repo-memory/cmd_hook.go#L193-L206) in [`hookRunE`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/cmd/repo-memory/cmd_hook.go#L107) for `PreToolUse` events.
   - Preserved top-level panic recovery (lines 45-51) and fast-path enrollment checks (lines 85-93) fail-open returning `{"decision":"allow"}`.

3. **Tests & Isolation (`internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go`)**:
   - [`TestPreToolUse_AllowByDefault`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L35): empty JSON, empty string, invalid JSON, minimal payload.
   - [`TestPreToolUse_FastExits`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L58): disabled flags, housekeeping guard, non-edit tools (`view_file`, `run_command`), unenrolled repos, missing arguments.
   - [`TestPreToolUse_Normalization`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L112): verifies snake_case to camelCase conversion.
   - [`TestPreToolUse_EditWithNoGate`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L141): allows edit when no gate entry exists.
   - [`TestPreToolUse_EditWithGate`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L171): verifies `force_ask` response containing `[REPO-MEMORY` tag, entry ID, and prompt text.
   - Added [`TestMain`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse_test.go#L15-L33) to isolate tests from ambient environment variables.
